locator.section: pinned source key Sancti/10-DU; resolved section [Lectio] with declared inherited references

entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data provide a derived comparison witness. The transcription error creatúra is retained in that witness and explicitly corrected against the approved Benziger printing.

The opening of the complete reading is printed on p.712/n793 and continues on p.713/n794. The genitive creaturae is secure against the electronic typo creatura. The continuation has its own source binding.

locator.section: Continuation of Colossians1 reading, ending before Graduale

entries.claim: The continuation completes the 137-word reading, including In Christo Iesu Domino nostro. No Amen or oration conclusion is added.
